pricing.explanation: 8% only on every successful sale. No setup fees, no monthly subscription, no hidden charges — anywhere.
pricing.netNote: Deposited straight to your bank account in EGP or equivalent supported currency

items.a: Ebdaey is an all-in-one platform that lets creators launch their own digital academy and sell recorded courses, digital products, and consultation bookings effortlessly and professionally, with no technical experience needed.
There is no monthly subscription or setup fee. Build and design your site for free and pay just 8% on every successful sale — whether it's a course, digital product, or consultation.

items.q: Which payment methods can customers use?
items.a: For customers in Egypt: Visa, Mastercard, Meeza, and mobile wallets (Vodafone Cash, Etisalat Cash, Orange Money) in EGP via PayMob. For international customers: Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, and Google Pay in USD or their local currency via Stripe.

items.q: How do I receive my earnings?
items.a: Your earnings are transferred directly to your bank account. Submit a withdrawal request from your dashboard and it will be processed within a few business days.

items.q: Can I sell to customers outside Egypt in USD or foreign currencies?
items.a: Yes, absolutely! With our international Stripe integration, you can sell to buyers anywhere in the world in USD, SAR, AED, EUR, GBP, and more. You can set a global USD price or define custom per-country prices in local currencies with automatic location detection.

Ebdaey is built specifically for Arab educators and creators: a sleek Arabic-first interface, dual payment gateways (local PayMob + global multi-currency Stripe), per-country dynamic pricing, and an 8% commission model with no monthly subscriptions.
